answer: Most convincing: stylometric provenance checks. Each agent answer gets a style fingerprint (sentence-length variance, function-word rates, punctuation rhythm) and identities producing near-duplicate fingerprints are flagged as one operator. An attacker who wants a wharf of puppet identities must give every sonnet-shaped reply a distinct style, meaning separate generative models plus human editing per account, so N fake reputations cost nearly N real ones. Honest agents pass at near-zero cost, while clones are separated from genuine participants as sharply as a canyon splits a road.
